name: Ryoujoku Shuuyoujo -Zetsubou no Mirai-
original_name: 陵辱収容所-絶望の未来-
source:
Main character abducts women who betrayed him and puts them in his custody. What's on the other side of despair? Hatred? Revenge? Forgiveness?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-may-2008-g-senjou-no-maou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角绑架了背叛他的女性并将她们拘留。绝望的另一面是什么？仇恨？复仇？饶恕？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-may-2008-g-senjou-no-maou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
